sentences.text:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY For the Petitioner : Mr.
Shekhar Prasad Sinha, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Srivastava, A.P.P. For the O.P.
No.2 : Mr. Abhijeet Kumar Singh, Advocate ------
Order No.05 Dated : 19.08.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Jay Mangal Hazra is in custody since 01.03.2023 in connection with C.P. Case No.
3412 of 2019 for the offence registered under Sections 464, 466, 467, 468, 471, 474, 420 of the I.P.C.
pending in the Court of learned J.M. 1st Class, Dhanbad.

As per the case of the complainant, on the basis of the forged power of attorney purported to be executed by father of the complainant, petitioner sold by different plots of land by registered sale deeds executed in the year 2018, causing wrongful loss of Rupees Fifty Lakhs to the complainant.

It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the petitioner was acquainted with the father of the complainant and cheque no.947946 was drawn on 26.06.2018 and Rs.5,00,000/-
was paid to the complainant which was dishonored and thereafter, he paid Rs.10,00,000/- by another cheque bearing no.947945.
The power of attorney was not forged and it was duly executed by the father of the complainant.
The complaint case has been filed on 07.11.2019 whereas the power of attorney was executed on 09.07.2018.
Learned A.P.P. assisted by the counsel on behalf of the complainant have opposed the prayer for bail.

It is submitted by learned counsel on behalf of complainant that on the basis of forged and fabricated power of attorney, in total, eight sale deeds were executed by this petitioner, but no amount has been paid to the complainant.
The said power of attorney was not executed at Dhanbad where the complainant resides, but it was deliberately executed in Kolkata by imposter in place of father of complainant.

rejected.
Learned Court below is directed to expedite the trial.
